# Leaderboard: synthetic benchmark (SW1)

<!-- generated by scripts/build_leaderboard.py; do not edit by hand -->

**Every table on this page is the synthetic benchmark (SW1), except the companion rows on the sensitivity dataset in the gate section**. SW1 is `sw1_config()` after Amendment A1 (spec A1.4): generator seed 0, 20 personas, 90 days, all 8 attack families, attack rate 0.015, magnitude_mode "far" (a magnitude spike lands at or beyond magnitude_far_mult 5 × the persona's benign p99 of the field) and magnitude_topup_rate 0.015 (a second, magnitude-only pass) (dataset `a455b10c705d`). It is *not* the live sandbox dataset v1 (2,000+ sessions of real LLM agents), which has not been built yet; see the README for how to build it. The Tier-2 exit numbers belong to that dataset.

AUPRC and every other dataset-wide number on this page are not comparable with the pre-A1 leaderboard (snapshot `6451d56`): the SW1 attack mix changed (magnitude spikes are now about a third of the attacks; spec A1.5 rule 5).

Protocol: oracle-reviewer approval loop (labels act as a perfect human reviewer → optimistic), default engine configuration, full test split. The engine is also shown under spec §5.2 allow-all (row `engine-allow-all`), and the engine before Amendment A1 (`EngineConfig().replace(**PRE_A1_SWITCHES)`) under both protocols (rows `engine-pre-a1` and `engine-pre-a1-allow-all`); every row's caveat names its protocol. The baselines do not learn online, so the protocol does not change their scores. The by-time and by-agent splits are separate tables and are never averaged (§5.3). `llm_judge` is listed but was not run: it needs a live judge model and is evaluated on a stratified 2,000-envelope sample (§5.5), which only the sandbox dataset run will do.

The leaderboard's per-agent FPR@95 is an operating point fixed after the fact on the test labels (spec §5.4). It is not the engine's live calibration.

Tier-1 gate (spec A1.7; live per-agent thresholds, split `time`): on this dataset the amended gate passes under oracle-reviewer approval loop (labels act as a perfect human reviewer → optimistic) and is not met under spec §5.2 allow-all. Which protocol's result closes Tier 1 is the user's open decision (D-028); a pass under oracle-reviewer approval loop (labels act as a perfect human reviewer → optimistic) alone is a pass under that protocol only. See [docs/decisions/008-tier1-gate.md](decisions/008-tier1-gate.md) and [docs/writeup.md](writeup.md).

The companion rows on the sensitivity dataset (seed 0, magnitude_far_mult = 1.0, dataset `3fc612ce1fdb`; both engines, both protocols) are copied from `docs/decisions/evidence/a1-gate/matrix.json` (Task 1.23); this script does not replay that dataset.

## Tier-1 gate under both protocols

Rows from the leaderboard runs, split `time`: `engine`: runs `engine` (oracle-reviewer approval loop (labels act as a perfect human reviewer → optimistic)) and `engine-allow-all` (spec §5.2 allow-all); `pre-A1 engine (defaults + PRE_A1_SWITCHES)`: runs `engine-pre-a1` (oracle-reviewer approval loop (labels act as a perfect human reviewer → optimistic)) and `engine-pre-a1-allow-all` (spec §5.2 allow-all).

Warm test rows at live per-agent thresholds, attack level (slow_drift excluded). Amended criterion (spec A1.7): per family attack recall >= 0.9 and among-the-reasons share >= 0.9, benign FPR <= 0.02. Among = share of detected attacks with the targeted detector among the reasons (score > reason_min) of a flagged row; top-1 = the original spec §9 criterion, reported and not gated. Each line is the result under one protocol; the two lines are shown together and neither alone is the Tier-1 gate result. Which protocol closes Tier 1 is the user's open decision (D-028).

The magnitude_spike cell is shown only with its two companion rows (spec A1.5 rule 4): the engine before Amendment A1 on the same dataset (`pre-A1 engine (defaults + PRE_A1_SWITCHES)`, the leaderboard runs `engine-pre-a1` and `engine-pre-a1-allow-all`) and the amended engine on the sensitivity dataset (`magnitude_far_mult = 1.0`, rows copied from `docs/decisions/evidence/a1-gate/matrix.json`), printed after the main blocks.
